description: Template for scripts/run-benchmark-linux.sh. Copy to benchmark-datasets.json, point the inputs at local data, and edit the id/paths; the real manifest is intentionally not committed (it names private 4TB data). Each entry runs one `linxira-bio benchmark run`. source_url, when present, is rendered in summary.md next to the advantage entry and should point at the public provenance of the dataset (see docs/BENCHMARK_DATA_SOURCES.md).
